rationale: Stable v1.82.0 has a misaligned hue thumb and platform-native saturation/brightness ranges. Restore a coherent existing colour-selection surface using the owner-approved UI-016, without new settings or data.

summary.en: Align colour-picker thumbs and show the selected colour with live saturation and brightness gradients.
